exportAcceptance.localReview: Load a locally exported MP4/WebM/QuickTime file directly in-browser for metadata and visual review.
automaticChecks: Last deterministic capture exists for selected format
Capture frame clock within ±2 terminal frames
Capture ends at exact 180° Open endpoint
Master Pair geometry passed at capture
Export aspect ratio within 1.5% of target
Export duration within max(0.35s, 4/fps) of deterministic capture
Resolution warning when shortest side is below 720px
manualChecks: Motion Blur — no compression smear or double shell
Hinge — no flash, tear, or seam jump
Open Endpoint — final frame remains stable
Crop Safety — device and key content remain inside target
Compression — RedBlack contrast and fine edges remain readable
reviewHelpers: Review Hinge jumps exported video to mid-fold
Review End jumps to final Open hold
exportAcceptance.acceptanceRule: EXPORT PASS requires automatic QC pass plus 5/5 manual visual PASS.
exportAcceptance.formatIsolation: 16:9, 1:1 and 9:16 acceptance states are tracked independently.

note: Platform transcoding itself is not simulated; compression quality remains a manual acceptance item after reviewing the actual exported/transcoded clip.
